findings.title: Dual queryKey for the same bookings endpoint
findings.detail: BookingsPage uses ['operations-bookings', role] while DashboardPage and EarningsPage use ['vendor-bookings'] for the same GET /bookings/vendor/me call. A booking state transition on BookingsPage (start, complete) invalidates only the operations-bookings cache, leaving Dashboard and Earnings stat cards and revenue charts stale until the vendor re-navigates. Fix: add qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['vendor-bookings'] }) in BookingsPage's mutation onSuccess, or consolidate both pages onto a single queryKey.

findings.title: Modal missing ARIA dialog role
findings.detail: Modal.jsx renders without role="dialog" and aria-modal="true". Screen readers won't identify the layer as a dialog or restrict virtual cursor navigation to modal content. Add both attributes to the modal container div.
